main_text.p: Praxis est tùm Genesis, tùm Analysis. Praxis.
Genesis est, quâ opus proprio marte con-teximus. Genesis.
Analysis est, quâ opus alienum reteximus. Analysis.
Forma institutionis est ipse intelligendi ordo ratione tàm docentis, quàm discen-tis.

Ordo intelligendi supponit ordinem sen-tiendi: & uterq; varios admittit gradus, de quibus nunc ordine videndum. Hoc enim fine superiora illa sunt disputata de facultatibus superio-ribus & inferioribus. Quum autem varia sint philo-sophorum de gradibus cognitionis sententia, eas summatim commemorabo, & ex iis scalam intelle-ctus exquisitam eruere conabor. Dicam ergo de sententia' Cabbalistarum, Platonicorum, & Aristo-telicorum.

page.notes: The centred fleuron (decorative ornament) between the text and the signature is not transcribed. The signature "L" is printed at the foot below it. Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The apostrophe after "sententia" is printed as a mark and is kept as shown.
